provenance.notes: REST API page read 2026-11-10: 100 requests a minute and 15 a second per IP address, HTTP 429 above either; a client sending many requests (crawling) should set a descriptive User-Agent such as "MyResearchProject/1.0 (contact: name@example.org)" (asked, not required for every client); bulk access through the flat-file downloads. About page: the Catalog and its contents fall under the general EMBL-EBI Terms of Use; summary statistics CC0 unless stated; logos and diagrams CC BY 4.0. EMBL-EBI terms: no additional restriction on use or redistribution beyond the data owners' rights; attribution expected ("expects attribution ... in publications, services or products"); access only through the provided interfaces; use that threatens the service can be blocked. Commercial use not addressed explicitly; allowed read from "no additional restrictions". Citation suggested in this package's README (Cerezo M. et al., NAR 2025, doi:10.1093/nar/gkae1070) not re-read on the citation page.
